name: ClassEval
description: ClassEval is a manually constructed benchmark for evaluating large language models on class-level Python code generation tasks, focusing on the more challenging scenario of generating entire classes rather than standalone methods.
reputation: A recent manually constructed benchmark for class-level Python code generation that is useful for evaluating harder code synthesis capabilities, but is not yet broadly established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Benchmark focuses on class-level code generation, highlighting the gap between method-level and class-level generation abilities of LLMs.
